name: Portge
tagline: White-glove logistics for goods that deserve better than a barcode.
positioning: Portge is the enterprise logistics layer for small-batch and handcrafted goods — chain-of-custody, provenance, and last-mile care in one platform.

hero.h1: Logistics with the craftsmanship your product already has.
hero.sub: Portge moves limited-run, handmade, and high-provenance goods across the enterprise supply chain — with verifiable custody, climate-aware routing, and handling instructions that actually get read.

features.title: Provenance ledger
features.description: Every maker, material, and handoff recorded on an immutable chain-of-custody record your compliance team can audit in seconds.

features.title: Handling profiles
features.description: Attach fragility, temperature, and orientation rules to each SKU so warehouse and courier staff see the right instructions at every touch.

features.title: Artisan network
features.description: Onboard independent makers and micro-fulfillment partners with vetted SLAs, insurance, and capacity in a single vendor console.

features.title: Climate-aware routing
features.description: Route around heat, humidity, and vibration risk with lanes tuned for perishable, ceramic, and fine-finish inventory.

features.title: Live custody tracking
features.description: Watch each parcel move through hands and hubs in real time, with exception alerts before a shipment ever goes dark.

features.title: Usage that scales
features.description: Pay per shipment and per custody event — no seat licenses, no shelfware, just spend that tracks your actual volume.

testimonials.quote: We ship 400 hand-thrown stoneware collections a month. Portge cut breakage claims by 61% and gave our auditors a custody trail they stopped questioning.
testimonials.name: Marisol Chen

testimonials.quote: Our makers are in twelve countries. Portge's artisan network let us standardize SLAs without flattening what makes each partner worth working with.
testimonials.name: Declan O'Brien

testimonials.quote: The handling profiles alone justified the contract. Couriers finally handle our lacquerware the way the invoice says they should.
testimonials.name: Priya Raghunathan

pricing.blurb: For growing brands formalizing custody on their first high-value lines.
For scaling operations that need custody events and artisan onboarding.
For global supply chains with audit, insurance, and integration demands.

homepage.footerBlurb: Portge is the custody and care layer for artisanal logistics — moving considered goods across the enterprise without losing the story behind them.
